pins.name: lora_reset

prototype_only.waiver: Strapping pin GPIO 0 waived for prototype devkit use only.

imu_scl.rejection_reason: GPIO 22 is not physically present on the ESP32-S3 DevKitC-1 header pinout.

strapping_pin_fault.boot_mode: Download Bootloader Mode when sampled LOW on reset de-assertion
